title: Rajkummar Rao and Keerthy Suresh team up for ‘Raftaar’; film to release on this date - The Hindu
summary: Rajkummar Rao and Keerthy Suresh team up for ‘Raftaar’; Amazon MGM Studios announces film directed by Aditya Nimbalkar, set in a competitive education business, with a release date of July 24, 2026. Synopsis: fast-rising start-up, charged relationship, ambition, love, and greed.
sentiment_reason: The announcement of a new film release, while positive for the actors and production companies, carries a negative sentiment for the market due to the usual cautious approach investors take towards entertainment news without clear indicators of major financial impact.
